_about: OCR model sets of task ocr-any (ocr_any_task.py). name -> CRNN model dirs under models/ (in voting order: the first 'stage1' models are the cascade's stage 1 when hints exist), env switches of eciocr/prod/eci_ocr.py (all set explicitly, so the provenance is exact), hints mode ('required': the item must carry a hints key; 'none': run without hints even when the item has some; 'optional'), and the gold results at adoption. A new set = one entry here + its model dirs (crnn.onnx + charset.json) committed; sha256_16 / charset_sha256_16 = first 16 hex chars of the sha256 of crnn.onnx / charset.json (both checked by the task before the first item). FROZEN ONCE DEPLOYED: after the first item of a set has run on the pool, its entry (models, sha256_16, env, stage1) is never changed; a change is a new set (new name), so ocr_model_set + ocr_code name the exact rules and models of every record (model_sha256_16 is only in the part summary). The sets below are not deployed yet (2026-11-25 ocrv5 review fixes went into v4a before the first run). Every set names every eci_ocr decision switch (ECI_* read by eciocr/prod and eciocr/ocr), also those without effect for its hints mode; ECI_RESCALE_H and ECI_DIGIT_CRNN are listed with the values that are the code defaults ('' = off). ocr-any removes every other ECI_* variable; only ECI_OCR_WORKERS and ECI_TESS_CLI pass (speed / call path); ECI_CRNN is only the default when no --crnn is given (ocr-any always gives them). Review 3 (2026-11-25, before any deploy): ECI_CODE_VALID=1 and ECI_PARTNO_LIST=1 added to every set (see eci_ocr.post_rules). formocr (2026-11-25): set j5r4 for the form-route rolls; 'aux' lists further files under models/ that the env names as <models>/NAME (checked like the models). Switches added to the code after a set was frozen (the job2 / job5 NOHINT_*, EPIC_STATE, PAREN_GUARD, CONFW_SKIP) are not in the older sets: ocr-any removes every other ECI_* variable, so for those sets they stay at their code default (off). engocr (2026-11-25): sets engD, engJ (English) and tamH2, tamN2 (Tamil) for the SIR rolls of eci-rolls-all-cdn; new keys: 'lang' (ENG / TAM; absent = HIN; a set is used only on items of its language, also by a hub swap), 'arch_sha256_16' (arch.json of a model, read by eci_ocr for the input stretch 'xs'; checked like the model), 'stage1_nohint' (--stage1 also without hints: job4 / lang-tam no-hint cascade), 'args' (extra eci_ocr arguments, only --tess2), 'draft_records' (a final roll reads the item's draft records). These sets name EVERY switch of the merged code, also main's Hindi rules (off: their job evaluations ran without them). engK11 (job4 round 3, 10:20) is the planner's default English no-hint set; engJ stays defined (hot-swap back: ocr_model_set_map {"engK11": "engJ"}).

panH4.about: Punjab SIR (lang-pan round 3, owner 2026-11-26 deploy): every S19 AC has a 2027 Punjabi roll (hints). 3 int8 CRNNs (half + quarter + base) + Tesseract pan; cascade stage1 2; Punjabi canonical hint compare (ECI_PAN_CANON) and CTC fit of the 2027 value (ECI_PAN_HINTCTC=-10 mean margin, unflag). Engine branch lang-pan 0c86116. Native-resolution pages (ECI_RESCALE_H=0: segment_pan2 pitch is measured on the 2806 px SIR print). Gold (707 boxes, 24 pages, ACs 36 48 95 97 102 112, never trained on): record 99.15 %, unflagged 100 %, flags 1.98 %, 0 silent, EPIC 100 %; 0.134 CPU-s/record.

lbR5.about: West Bengal SIR Bengali (lang-ben round 5, owner 2026-11-26 deploy; below the 97 % record target but accepted: unflagged ~97-100 %, gap is flag rate). No hints. 2 int8 CRNNs (half + quarter, trained on Assam 2027 + pseudo-labelled WB + Opus-labelled lines) + Tesseract ben; no-hint cascade stage1 2 (both CRNNs agree); component line assignment (ECI_BEN_COMP, COMP_DOT), mark-variant lexicon guard (ECI_BEN_LEX ben_lex.json), stamp relation flag, CTC one-mark-variant guard (ECI_BEN_CTCVAR=-5), house guards. Native-resolution pages (ECI_RESCALE_H=0). Engine branch lang-ben 7530a4f. Gold v1.1 (688 boxes) with cross-roll repair: record 97.53 %, unflagged 99.67 %, flag 11.19 %, 2 silent. Held-out gold v2 (300 boxes, 10 unused ACs): record 94.67 %, unflagged 97.37 %, flag 11.33 %, 7 silent. Cross-roll repair (tools/xroll_repair.py) applies where both rolls of a part are OCR'd.

gold.source: lang-ben eval g2 (gold2 held-out) + gold v1.1 with xroll repair

oriN4s.about: Odisha SIR Odia (lang-ori round 5 oriN4s, owner 2026-11-26 deploy; silent-first: 0 silent on gold, high flag rate accepted - unflagged 100 % on gold). No hints (no 2027 Odia roll). 2 int8 CRNNs (r11 half + quarter, fine-tuned on real + Opus labels + rare-cluster synth) + Tesseract ori/eng; no cascade (stage1 0, all engines read every box). Serial / EPIC from Tesseract (ECI_ORI_TESS_NUM, the print's Latin digit font is unseen by the CRNNs); Odia parse fixes (ORI_FIX), house/age Latin by CRNN unanimity (ORI_DIGITS), out-of-lexicon name flag (ECI_ORI_LEX=F, ori_lex.json in the engine), component line slicing (ORI_SLICE, ORI_SPLIT2). Native-resolution pages (ECI_RESCALE_H=0). Engine branch lang-ori c02dd0a. Gold (696 boxes, ACs 1 35 64 91 106 124): record 94.54 %, unflagged 100 % (233 unflagged records, 0 silent), flag 66.52 %, EPIC 100 %. Held-out flag 82.1 %.

gold.source: lang-ori eval r11ab_f (eval/out/r11ab_f.score.json)

gujR4.about: Gujarat SIR Gujarati (lang-guj round 4, set key gujR4 = r9 models; owner 2026-11-26: DEFINE ONLY, DO NOT SEED - 89.64 % record is well below the 97 % target; every record is flagged). No hints (no 2027 Gujarati roll). 3 int8 CRNNs (r9 = r8 fine-tuned on real pseudo-labels + 29k Opus A==B hard-line labels + synth) + Tesseract guj; no cascade (stage1 0); band segmentation (segment_guj), strict agreement guard (ECI_GUJ_AGREE / guj_agree), CRNN-pair merge (ECI_GUJ_MERGE), word-evidence lexicon correction (ECI_GUJ_LEX guj_lex3.json in the engine), relation_label by CRNN majority (ECI_GUJ_LABEL_CRNN), house digit guards. Native-resolution pages (ECI_RESCALE_H=0). Engine branch lang-guj d1e5644 / 38e880a. Gold v2 (695 boxes, 8 ACs): record 89.64 % (skip-uncertain 92.66 %), EPIC 100 %, 100 % flagged, 0 record-level silent. NOTE: the merged engine's shared decide() flags EPIC on no-Tesseract boxes where the lang-guj branch accepted the CRNN-unanimous value; field VALUES are identical (record accuracy unchanged) and every record is flagged already.
